summary: Confirmatory one-shot of the FROZEN O4 recipe on the 108-window round-3 hold-out (92 good/16 bad, 44 factories). O4 (b) E5-8+Z3-6: AUROC 0.676 [0.525,0.827] grouped, BA 0.648; O4 (a) Z3-6 0.675 [0.523,0.822]; sharpness-3 head 0.715 [0.579,0.841], BA 0.552; frozen two-view ensemble 0.690 [0.534,0.823]. Paired grouped delta O4(b)-frozen -0.009 [-0.197,0.177], P>0=0.47. Pooled-160 gap (0.781 vs 0.566) does NOT replicate: O4 generalises worse and the ensemble is stronger here. Scored once; no tuning.
decision: Do not adopt O4 on the confirmatory test; do not use the pooled-160 0.781 as a generalisation claim.
cost: CPU feature extraction + GPU two-view ensemble (108 windows); no tuning
